card.name: Inside romanized Asian names and PML
card.fires_on: Pieces inside romanized Vietnamese or Chinese names and titles, such as Linh Son, Thich Thien Tri, Fu Li-kuo, and Zhong Hua Nei Ke Za Zhi. Also the letters inside the abbreviation PML.

modes.label: Romanized Asian names
modes.description: Middle syllables of Vietnamese or Chinese pinyin names of people, pagodas and journals.

modes.label: PML abbreviation
modes.description: The ML piece after P in the abbreviation PML in JC virus antibody text.
modes.example: have a lower risk of P<<ML>> than those who are positive

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese character pieces and odd fragments, so the output effect is unclear and mixed.
card.plain: It fires partway through spelled-out Vietnamese or Chinese names, and inside the abbreviation PML.
